items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the functoriality of rational equivalence under flat pullback: rationally equivalent cycles pull back to rationally equivalent cycles, with the relative dimension shift (statement lines 3172-3179, tag 02S1). The proof unwinds rational equivalence into a locally finite family of principal divisors, verifies that the pulled back family is locally finite, passes to the fibre products over the source and rewrites the pulled back sum as a sum of pushforwards of pulled back principal divisors, each of which is rationally trivial by the prepared flat pullback statement, and then concludes for the sum. The rewriting through the fibre products is the substance, so the claim is H2.
